name: Yeva, Nature's Herald
oracle_text:
Flash (You may cast this spell any time you could cast an instant.)
You may cast green creature spells as though they had flash.
blocked_sentences: You may cast green creature spells as though they had flash.

needs.what: a spell filter (affects_spells: {types: ["Creature"], colors: ["G"]}) on the player-wide cast_as_though_flash static, so the timing permission covers only green creature spells the controller casts, including cards drawn after the source arrived
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cast_as_though_flash is unfiltered: the loader refuses 'affects'/'amount' on it and reads no 'affects_spells', so it would grant flash to every spell (a strictly better card). grant_flash_permission takes 'types' but not colors and needs a timed duration, so it cannot be a static that lasts while Yeva is on the battlefield; grant_keyword flash is not read by casting._timing_ok and cannot reach cards in hand
